name: Samuel Whitney
role: Medora settler, constable and hotel landlord
bio: Samuel (Sam) Whitney settled in Medora in April 1885, setting up house in Bob Roberts's building, and won second place in the fat men's race at that year's Fourth of July sports. He was elected a Billings County constable in November 1886 and that month was to take over a Medora hotel as landlord.
mentions: Sam. Whitney has decided to make Medora his home and has gone to housekeeping in Bob Roberts building. His eldest daughter arrived last evening.
